# Live E2E Corrective Requirements Checklist: Git-native Grove

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality gate for the five defects reproduced by the installed Grove 0.3.0 live end-to-end acceptance run **Created**: 2026-08-24 **Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) **Reproduction source**: a live-E2E report kept outside the repository (see `reviews/live-e2e-correction-20260824.md` for the corrections it drove)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` workflow based on feature context and requirements. **Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. **Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is terminal operation-record secrecy specified over the complete serialized record, rather than only a dedicated secret field or credential-bearing URL components? [Completeness, Contract V3OPS-05, Spec §FR-033A]
- [ ] CHK002 Is destructive-refusal disclosure defined as one complete inventory containing both uncommitted Tree paths and loose Grove content when both are simultaneously at risk? [Completeness, Constitution IV, Spec §FR-033A-B]
- [ ] CHK003 Is advisory Tree order defined for every presentation consumer after persistence, including the next `tree ls`, rather than only the `tree reorder` result? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 Are unregister-only result facts defined separately for a managed bare common repository and an externally linked normal checkout/common directory? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037, Decision 001]
- [ ] CHK005 Are stale-agent-reference diagnostics defined for workspace, Grove, and Tree preferences when an agent definition is removed? [Completeness, Constitution II, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement clarity and consistency

- [ ] CHK006 Is the operation-record rule unambiguous that a credential-free public remote URL is still a raw remote and must not survive in a terminal record? [Clarity, Contract V3OPS-05]
- [ ] CHK007 Are refusal and forced-run itemization requirements consistent about the exact loose paths and uncommitted paths each mode must disclose? [Consistency, Constitution IV, Spec §FR-033A-C]
- [ ] CHK008 Is Tree ordering explicitly advisory presentation state without becoming authoritative evidence of Tree existence, refs, or worktree membership? [Consistency, Constitution I-II, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK009 Is `commonGitDirRetained` distinguished from `checkoutRetained` using the authoritative managed-add versus external-link topology? [Clarity, Decision 001, Spec §FR-011A-E, §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK010 Is stale agent preference behavior consistent with the rule to retain advisory preferences and diagnose them without blocking Git? [Consistency, Constitution II, Spec §FR-016]

## Acceptance criteria and scenario coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Can V3OPS-05 be objectively witnessed by searching the entire completed operation serialization for the exact supplied remote? [Measurability, Contract V3OPS-05]
- [ ] CHK012 Does destructive coverage include the combined dirty-Tree plus loose-Grove refusal in both human and JSON modes before a separately authorized forced run? [Coverage, Constitution IV, Spec §FR-033A-C]
- [ ] CHK013 Does ordering coverage require a write-then-fresh-read witness with two repositories and omission semantics, not merely manifest persistence? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK014 Does repository-removal coverage compare reported retained topology with raw Git bare/common-directory facts for both managed and linked registrations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK015 Does agent coverage remove an actively referenced default and require a stable doctor diagnostic and strict-mode classification without mutating Git? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Constitution V]
- [ ] CHK016 Is completion measurable through focused red/green witnesses, the full local verification suite, a rebuilt installed CLI, and fresh live reproductions of all five findings? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-051A-B, §003-git-native-grove-SC-013-SC-017]

## Scope boundary

- [ ] CHK017 Is the corrective work explicitly limited to the five reproduced defects and their proof gaps, excluding new commands, capabilities, migration, CI/platform expansion, and unrelated cleanup? [Scope, Plan §Design and Traceability Rules]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- Implementation completion is tracked by T104–T109 in `../tasks.md`, not by these markers.
- Add comments or findings inline and link any later review disposition to the corresponding CHK ID.
